newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Brash says NZ exporters under great pressure.
newsitem.headline: Brash says NZ exporters under great pressure.

text.p: Reserve Bank of New Zealand Governor Don Brash said on Thursday he recognised exporters were under great pressure.

Brash told reporters at a conference of exporters in Wellington: "The main point I want to reflect by our being here is to recognise the considerable pressure that exporters are under, but beyond that I don't want to say any more at this point."

Asked if he could offer any comfort to exporters, Brash said: "I've acknowledged the fact that exporters are under very considerable pressure, and my presence here today reflects my recognition of that, but I don't want to say any more."
Brash's speech to the gathering was off the record, and the press were not invited. The conference has been called to consider responses to the high level of the New Zealand dollar.
